config.mid_price_rounding: round_half_up (X.5 rounds up to X+1), per AMENDMENT-20260721-H0005-pre-execution.md Finding 5
config.outcome_derivation: settlement/labels.py implied_result(value_at_settlement, strike_type, floor_strike, cap_strike); requires settlement_label_status == 'resolved'
config.rng_consumption_order: single random.Random(20260721); discovery-slice cells (horizon ascending [2,6,12,24,48,72] outer, decile ascending inner, 60 calls) then hold-out-slice cells, same nested order, unconditional for all 60 cells (120 calls total); no other statistic consumes randomness -- AMENDMENT Finding 3
config.bootstrap_pool_separation: discovery bootstrap resamples only discovery-slice days; holdout bootstrap resamples only holdout-slice days; pools never mixed -- AMENDMENT Finding 2
config.replication_split: chronological halves of the valid-day population, 1-day embargo at the boundary
config.split_tie_break: if the post-embargo day count is odd, discovery slice receives the extra (earliest) day -- AMENDMENT Finding 8
config.evaluation_order: 1) total-day floor -> inconclusive; 2) any cell clears both screens -> rejected; 3) any discovery-passing cell insufficient_n in holdout -> inconclusive-for-power; 4) otherwise confirmed -- AMENDMENT Finding 4
config.empty_cell_handling: N=0 cell: calibration_error null, excluded from ECE weighted sum, contributes zero rows to regression -- AMENDMENT Finding 7
config.close_time_immutability_evidence: Queried market_snapshots directly (2026-07-21): for every KXHIGHNY/KXLOWTNYC market_ticker in the archive (828 distinct markets, 828 market_snapshots rows -- i.e. every snapshot row belongs to one of these two series), count(distinct close_time) grouped by market_ticker == 1 for all 828 markets (0 markets with >1 distinct close_time). close_time is empirically immutable across the entire pinned population, not just a sample -- AMENDMENT Finding 6.

decision_rule.confirmed_if: no primary-family cell clears both the Bonferroni-adjusted discovery-slice screen and the hold-out replication screen
decision_rule.rejected_if: at least one primary-family cell clears both screens
decision_rule.inconclusive_if: settlement_days_available < 60, OR every discovery-screen-passing cell falls below min_days_per_cell in the holdout slice
decision_rule.evaluation_order: 1) total-day floor -> inconclusive; 2) any cell clears both screens -> rejected; 3) any discovery-passing cell insufficient_n in holdout -> inconclusive-for-power; 4) otherwise confirmed -- AMENDMENT Finding 4
decision_rule.reason: at least one primary-family cell cleared both the Bonferroni discovery screen and the hold-out replication screen
